## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a1dd46b592d8fcd67299f3002673b5205f366849`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

Read: card #32869 body and its one comment (claim 6837843903), the PR body and file list (4 files, +5 −8), the net diff `origin/main...pr/32881` (merge-base = `origin/main` `5fb79bc0`), and the head's check-runs. Nothing built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- `lanes/director.md` heading 「职责四:每日摘要、发版板与总表」 becomes 「职责四:发版板与总表」 and the 「每日摘要:…」 bullet goes: the director seat no longer owes a daily digest. **Right** — this is the card's ruling (「车队日报 routine 作废，不需要」).
- The three external-demand bullets (「外部需求行三数…」, 「① ② ③」, 「查法…」) go with it: the three non-fleet counts are no longer computed or presented by anyone. **Right** — see ③.
- `seat-lifecycle.md:67` loses 「五项健康指标进总监席的每日摘要」: the five health indicators lose that destination. **Right** — they are still defined at :73–77 inside the same 〈轮次报告与节奏〉 section and are still a segment of the triage close brief (`dispatch-runbook.md:51`), so they keep a carrier.
- `project-forms.md:58` loses 「总监席日报与」: the roster issue body is regenerated by 坐席/接管/移交 only. **Right as text, but it now contradicts `lanes/director.md:82`**, which this diff leaves saying the roster is regenerated 「随本摘要」 — see ④ finding 1.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: `lanes/director.md` ceiling 86 → 82. **Right** — the file is 82 lines at head; lowering is always legitimate.
- Implied and unstated: the roster's director-side regeneration trigger. On `main` it was the digest; the PR removes the digest from one end (`project-forms.md`) and leaves it at the other (`director.md:82`). **Wrong as landed** — the rule is half changed.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` matches: all four paths sit under `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**`, nothing published. The label is on the PR and `Check Changeset` concluded success. `Clause-②: no` is on the PR body and on the claim; correct — no consumer-facing behaviour is touched.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev reports no deviations and stayed inside the claimed file surface (the four files, the history comment near :1650 untouched).

The one conditional the card set — keep the external-demand rows only if another reading consumes them — is answered correctly. On `origin/main`, 「外部需求」 occurs at `lanes/director.md:73` and `:74` only, both removed; the `:75`/`:76` bullets are continuations of `:74`. The neighbouring term 「非车队卡」 (`execution-duties.md:58`, `check-half-states.mjs`) is the queue-ordering rule and carries its own definition inline; it does not read the removed rows. Removal stands.

No flag escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

**1. must-fix — `lanes/director.md:82` still hangs a duty on the retired digest.** The line reads 「车队总表随本摘要重生成,坐席/接管/收班同笔;…见 `../project-forms.md`」. 「本摘要」 pointed at the section's own 「每日摘要」 bullet; with that bullet and the heading word gone, the section defines no 摘要 for 「本」 to bind to. A director seat reading the section is told to regenerate the roster with a digest, so the line still presupposes the deliverable the card retires (Done-when: no line assigns a daily digest to any seat), and the roster's director-side trigger is left undefined. It also contradicts the file it points to: `project-forms.md:58`, edited in this same diff, now names 坐席/接管/移交 as the only regenerators. The card's grep (`日报|每日摘要|daily digest`) cannot see a bare 「摘要」, which is how it survived. Fix in place: drop 「随本摘要」 (for example 「车队总表坐席/接管/收班同笔重生成;…」); the count stays 82 and the ceiling needs no move.

**2. should-fix — five lines still route work to an undefined 「总监席摘要」.** `dispatch-runbook.md:39` (heading), `:41` (座位贴活性归总监席摘要), `:46` (总监席摘要列等候逾 24h 的 PR), `seat-lifecycle.md:33` (活性归总监席摘要) and `lanes/qa.md:8` (总监席摘要的新 tag 族读数). The removed bullet was the only line that listed this digest's contents, and `:46` and `qa.md:8` name two of them (复审逾 24h 的 PR, 发版板). They can be read as the per-session 「摘要台账」 (`director.md:41`, `SKILL.md:237`), which is why this is not a must-fix, but the text no longer says so. `seat-lifecycle.md:33` is in a `hits` file; the other four are outside the diff and are read here, not reviewed. Either re-point them at 摘要台账 in this PR or file the follow-up card.

**3. nit — `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs:113`** header comment still says 「the director seat's digest and any seat/takeover/handover call it」. Outside the diff; it belongs with whatever fixes finding 1.

Held, and tried:

- Out-of-scope duties untouched: `triage-duties.md` (每日一 fire, 每日看板), the release-board bullets (`director.md:75–81`), `project-forms.md:59`.
- The section otherwise reads coherently: heading, then the weekly ROADMAP re-read, release board, bump tickets, roster. `seat-lifecycle.md:67` (「项目席轮报 = 卡线程清单,⛔ 不逐轮发聊天表。」) and `project-forms.md:58` are whole sentences.
- Ratchet: `director.md` 82 lines = ceiling 82; `seat-lifecycle.md` 98 = 98 and `project-forms.md` 59 = 59, unmoved. The note 「86 → 82 (#32869): … retired; landed count.」 matches the line above it. The history comment at :1659 is untouched, and the other `director.md` rows (`ruledRaises` at :2449, the `0` row at :2566) need no change for a lowering.
- No pointer by the old title: 「职责四」 appears outside the file only in `check-governed-merges.mjs:417,445`, as comments naming the duty by number; no script matches the heading text.
- 120-byte cap held in all three skill files at head; no line re-wrapped.

Check-runs on this head. Concluded success: Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Plan Test Core shards, Auto Label, filter, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure. **Still in progress when read**, so not yet verdicts: Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, the four Type Check jobs, Test Core 1/8 and 2/8. None had failed. The line-ratchet's own verdict is therefore pending; the 82 = 82 reading above is a line count, not a gate run.

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `295963d9f8fe2d6933d1aa59ac395c48c918fa57`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs

Round 2. Baseline: the FAIL on `a1dd46b5` (comment 6838099464). Read: card #32869 body and both comments (claim 6837843903, restated claim 6838109975), the PR body and file list (7 files, +13 −16), the net diff `origin/main...pr/32881` (merge-base `5fb79bc0`; `main` has since moved to `75102c80` without touching any of the seven files or anything under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch`), the round-2 delta `a1dd46b5..295963d9` (5 files, +8 −8), and the head's check-runs. Nothing built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

Round 1, unchanged in this head and judged in the baseline: the 「职责四」 retitle, the 「每日摘要」 bullet and its three external-demand bullets removed, `seat-lifecycle.md:67` and `project-forms.md:58` clauses dropped, `lanes/director.md` ceiling 86 → 82. All **right**, as before.

Round 2:

- `lanes/director.md:82` 「车队总表随本摘要重生成,坐席/接管/收班同笔」 becomes 「车队总表由坐席/接管/收班同笔重生成」: the roster is regenerated by the seat events only; the director seat's digest is no longer a trigger. **Right** — it removes the dangling 「本摘要」 and agrees with `project-forms.md:58` that no digest regenerates the roster.
- `dispatch-runbook.md:39` heading, `:41`, `:46`, `seat-lifecycle.md:33`, `lanes/qa.md:8`: 「总监席摘要」 becomes 「总监席巡查」. Seat-post liveness, the list of PRs waiting over 24 h for review and the new-tag-family reading stay with the director seat; their vehicle is the seat's own patrol, not a report. **Right** — it follows the restated claim's ruling (the report is retired, not the checks), and it holds against the charter: `lanes/director.md:17–18` already has the director seat patrolling and auditing while in session (「未回字 = 不在 = 停,⛔ 无巡检、审计…」, 「回来后先补跑审计…」), `:80` is the new-tag-family reading `qa.md:8` points at, and `triage-duties.md:83` already names a 「总监席活性复查」.
- Implied and unstated: the three checks lose their daily cadence and run when a director session is summoned. **Right** — the cadence was the retired routine's; `director.md:7` (人工召唤, ⛔ 无 Routine/cron) and `SKILL.md:71` (巡查 routine: 总监席除外) are untouched, so the word 「巡查」 does not hand the director seat a routine.
- Implied and unstated: the over-24 h list now has no named output. The digest was where it was printed; 「总监席巡查列…」 says who lists, not where. **Acceptable, not ideal** — see ④ finding 1.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` header: 「the director seat's digest and any seat/takeover/handover call it」 becomes 「any seat/takeover/handover calls it」. Comment only, no code. **Right**.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` holds: all seven paths are under `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**`, nothing published; the label is on the PR. `Clause-②: no` is on the PR body and the claim and is correct — five skill-text rewrites, one ceiling row and one header comment; no consumer-facing behaviour.

### ③ Boundary flags

Baseline findings:

- **must-fix 1 (`director.md:82`) — answered.** 「随本摘要」 is gone; the line is a whole sentence and no longer presupposes a digest.
- **should-fix 2 (five 「总监席摘要」 lines) — answered**, by re-pointing at the director seat's patrol instead of 摘要台账, under the seat ruling in the restated claim. All five lines changed; none left.
- **nit 3 (`fleet-roster.mjs` header) — answered.**

Restated surface respected. The delta's hunks are exactly `dispatch-runbook.md` :39, :41, :46; `director.md` :82; `qa.md` :8; `seat-lifecycle.md` :33; `fleet-roster.mjs` :112–113. `dispatch-runbook.md:130` and `:143` (PR #32866, still open) are byte-identical to `main`. 「摘要台账」 is untouched at `SKILL.md:237`, `:275` and `director.md:36`, `:41`. The ratchet history comment at `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:1659` is untouched. Every delta hunk is one line for one line: no line added, none re-wrapped.

No flag escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

Done-when holds. Searching 日报, 每日摘要, 总监席摘要, 本摘要, 摘要 and daily digest over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch`, `AGENTS.md` and `scripts/pm` at this head leaves: 「摘要台账」 (`SKILL.md:237`, `:275`, `director.md:36`, `:41`), bare 「摘要」 at `director.md:54` and `seat-lifecycle.md:78`, and the two ratchet comments (`:1659` history, `:1668` this PR's note). None assigns a daily digest or daily report to a seat. `AGENTS.md` has no hit.

**1. should-fix (follow-up card, not this PR) — the director charter does not carry the patrol it is now cited for.** `lanes/director.md` has no line naming seat liveness or the over-24 h review list; on `main` the removed digest bullet was the charter's only mention of the latter. The duties are still assigned (`dispatch-runbook.md:41`, `:46`, `seat-lifecycle.md:33`), so nothing is lost, but a director session reading only its charter will not meet them, the charter says 「巡检」 (`:17`) where the three files now say 「巡查」, and the over-24 h list has no stated destination (the natural one is the 待您审合 line of the batch, `director.md:54`). One charter line would close it; that adds a line and needs its own ceiling ruling, which the card's 「no new duty」 scope and the claim's 「no line added」 rightly keep out of this PR.

**2. should-fix (pre-existing on `main`, follow-up) — the roster's third trigger is spelled three ways.** `director.md:82` says 坐席/接管/收班, `project-forms.md:58` says 坐席/接管/移交, `fleet-roster.mjs:113` says seat/takeover/handover. 收班 (every shift close, `seat-lifecycle.md:37`) is not 移交 (a cross-account handover). The three now agree on what this card is about — no digest regenerates the roster — and the mismatch is not this diff's: both spellings are on `main`, and the baseline's own suggested wording kept 收班. Not blocking; one word in one file settles it.

**3. nit — two bare 「摘要」 remain in `hits` files, outside the hunks.** `director.md:54` (「呈批与摘要分写…」) and `seat-lifecycle.md:78` (「⛔ 不进维护者摘要」). Neither assigns a duty; the first reads against the 摘要台账 of `:36`/`:41`, the second is a prohibition inside the round-report section. Listed so the next reader does not rediscover them.

Held, and tried:

- Every rewritten line reads as a whole duty: 「座位贴活性归总监席巡查:扫…」, 「无心跳,活性归总监席巡查:逾一天无自有产出 ⇒…」, 「…总监席巡查列等候逾 24h 的 PR」, 「发版只认维护者一句或总监席巡查的新 tag 族读数」. The heading 「巡查常设项(每席巡查与总监席巡查)」 still covers its seven items, and the only reference to it by name (`check-half-states.mjs:15098`, a comment citing 「巡查常设项」) still resolves.
- No contradiction with the charter: nothing in the five lines requires a routine, a cron or work while the director seat is absent.
- Ratchet ceilings equal landed counts, read as line counts: `director.md` 82 = 82, `dispatch-runbook.md` 245 = 245, `seat-lifecycle.md` 98 = 98, `project-forms.md` 59 = 59, `lanes/qa.md` 29 = 29. Only the `director.md` row moved.
- 120-byte cap: the longest line is 120 bytes in `dispatch-runbook.md`, `director.md`, `project-forms.md` and `seat-lifecycle.md`, 119 in `qa.md`.
- Out-of-scope duties untouched: `triage-duties.md`, the release-board bullets, `project-forms.md:59`.

Check-runs on this head. Concluded success: Auto Label, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards (both runs), Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Type Check · workspace, filter. Check Changeset concluded skipped (both runs) with the `skip-changeset` label on the PR. **Still in progress when read**, so not yet verdicts: Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Plan Test Core shards, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates. None had failed. The line-ratchet's own verdict is among the pending ones; the ceiling readings above are line counts, not a gate run. This PASS is of the text; landing still waits on those runs going green.

Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4cwTZvo7tAGwbbRW2b8`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- **改了什么**:派发规则不再要求总监席出「每日摘要」:`lanes/director.md` 职责四去掉每日摘要与外部需求三行并改标题;`seat-lifecycle.md:67`、`project-forms.md:58` 去掉指向日报的半句;原本挂在「总监席摘要」上的三项检查(座位贴活性、复审逾 24h 的 PR、新 tag 族读数)改为「总监席巡查」,检查本身保留;车队总表改由坐席/接管/收班同笔重生成。行数棘轮 `director.md` 86 → 82。
- **为什么改**:维护者 2026-11-12 22:19Z 「车队日报 routine 作废，不需要」「立卡处理」。不改的话,读技能的座位会把日报重新做出来。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 PM 规则文本与一条棘轮上限、一行脚本注释;不进发布包。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`lanes/director.md` 职责四;`dispatch-runbook.md:39–46`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` 绿。
- **需要你做的**:无。Tier S,席位按契约复审 PASS 落地。
- **席位意见**:ACCEPT。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:skills#1 · head `295963d9f8fe2d6933d1aa59ac395c48c918fa57`

- **形态:** draft → main;`Fixes #32869` 首行;`skip-changeset`(只触 `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`,不发包)。作者 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`(经中继)。
- **前提实测:** 认领 6837843903 与重申 6838109975 读数成立;merge base `5fb79bc0` 后 `main` 未碰七个文件。
- **门禁 check-runs(现 head):** 48 个全部 completed:26 success · 22 skipped · 0 failed;含 Lint · PM dispatch-gates、Lint · repo & tooling gates、Governed Surface Queue Guard、PR-body guards。
- **契约复审:** 第一轮 FAIL 6838099464(head `a1dd46b5`,must-fix 1);第二轮 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER PASS 6838710619,本 head;must-fix 0 · should-fix 2(均为后续)· nit 1。
- **席位裁定(已在重申认领写明):** 维护者撤的是日报,不是日报里承载的检查;三项检查留给总监席巡查,`摘要台账`(每场裁决台账)不动。
- **接受的偏差:** 外部需求三行随日报删去(复审 ③ 核实无其它读者);nit(两处单独「摘要」不派职责)记为接受偏差。
- **范围外去向:** should-fix 1(总监席章程本身未写这三项巡查、逾 24h 清单无落点)与 should-fix 2(总表第三触发写成 收班/移交/handover 三种,`main` 上原有)都要加行或跨文件统一,超出本卡「不加职责」,记入卡 #32869 收口评论,待有承载卡时并入。
- **落地条款:** Tier S(`check-governed-merges --pr 32881`:GOVERNED — Tier S),K = 7 < 15,`mergeable_state: clean`;席位 `pr_ready` + auto-merge;不需人批。
